# K1 - ChatGPT shock x GenAI exposure (H12)

## Pre-registration (written before estimation)

- Outcomes: (i) 10-K AI mention indicator (dataset:45 v2), firm-year 2018-2026.
- Exposure: industry GenAI exposure, standardised.
- Model (i): y_it = a_i + l_t + sum_k b_k * Exposure * 1[t = k] + e; firm and year FE; wild-cluster bootstrap.
- Decision: supported if the mean post b > 0 with p < 0.05 and the pre-trend p > 0.10.
